meaning:
1) weapon, missile, sprout
1a) missile, weapon
1b) sprout, shoot

elsewhere.note: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house…
Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.
He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,
Neither does one jostle another; they march everyone in his path, and they burst through the defenses, and don’t break ranks.
